Active Defense Collective 

ProSOC® MDR’s proactive threat defense solution anticipates and prevents attacks by leveraging collective intelligence to identify and block threats in real-time, protecting your infrastructure before breaches occur. 

Stop Cyber Attacks Before They Start   

Active Defense Collective is our patent-pending solution that implements proactive blocks in your network to stop attacks before they even happen. These unprecedented preemptive actions are powered by real-time indicators from collective intelligence gathered from countless networks monitored by Proficio’s award-winning ProSOC service . 
As a leader in Managed Detection and Response (MDR) services, Proficio offers this cutting-edge solution as an evolution of our Active Defense XDR service.

Frequently Asked Questions 








What is Active Defense Collective?
+ 




Active Defense Collective is a proactive cybersecurity solution that prevents attacks by blocking threats in real-time. It leverages collective intelligence from monitored networks to stop threats before they reach your systems. 







How does Active Defense Collective detect threats?
+ 




It uses AI-driven analytics, machine learning, and human-led monitoring to identify malicious activity across endpoints, networks, and cloud systems, detecting threats before they can cause harm. 







What is the mean time to detect with Active Defense Collective?
+ 




With Active Defense Collective, threats are detected in 0 seconds on average, compared to 5 days without proactive solutions, enabling instant response to emerging risks. 







How does Active Defense Collective enhance existing security tools?
+ 




It integrates seamlessly with NGFWs, web application firewalls, and network security tools, unlocking SOAR capabilities to maximize the value of your current investments. 







Can Active Defense Collective automate threat responses?
+ 




Yes. Through custom SOAR playbooks, it automates actions like firewall rule changes, traffic blocking, and endpoint quarantine, allowing rapid containment without manual intervention. 







What is the role of collective intelligence in this solution?
+ 




Collective intelligence aggregates real-time threat data from global networks, enabling Active Defense Collective to anticipate attacks and proactively block threats across your organization. 







Does it provide reporting and dashboards?
+ 




Yes. The Active Defense Dashboard in ProView® Portal provides insights into blocked threats, trends, origins, and overall threat activity for executive and operational teams. 







How does it improve business resilience?
+ 




By stopping attacks before they happen and continuously monitoring threats, Active Defense Collective ensures minimal disruption, stronger security posture, and faster recovery from potential incidents. 







Who benefits most from Active Defense Collective?
+ 




Organizations with critical infrastructure, high-value data, or remote networks benefit most, gaining proactive defense, automated response, and enhanced visibility into security events. 







Is Active Defense Collective part of ProSOC MDR?
+ 




Yes. It is an advanced extension of ProSOC MDR, enhancing proactive defense, automated response, and threat intelligence capabilities to prevent cyber attacks before they occur.
